script.base: Morning-of read, weather not in the pack. LA is a 3-point favorite with implied totals LA 25.8 / LV 22.8 and a 48.5 total, so the base script is a competitive game, not a blowout. LA can lean on Kyren Williams (42 carries, 179 rush yards in weeks 4-6) against a LV run defense allowing 5.18 YPC, but the score stays close enough that both passing games stay live. LV's run game is stuck (Ashton Jeanty 35 carries, 107 yards, 3.06 YPC over those three weeks), so Kirk Cousins has to feed Brock Bowers (30 targets, 266 yards) and the checkdown to Jeanty (20 targets, 154 yards) to get to 22.8 points.
script.flip1: LA scores early, Stafford and Puka's volume stalls, and Kyren/Corum salt the clock. LV then abandons the run — Jeanty's last two rush lines are already 27 and 22 — and Bowers, Tre Tucker and Jeanty's targets spike while Kyren's rush line is the one that cashes.
script.flip2: LV hangs around or leads, both teams throw, and the middle of the field (LV allows 8.56 YPA middle; LA allows 7.18) turns it into a TE/RB-receiving game: Bowers, Mayer, Higbee and Jeanty clear together. The lower-probability third flip is a slog that drags 48.5 under and starves every yardage leg at once.

injury_fallout: Confirmed outs from the pre-game nflverse report: LA LB Nate Landman OUT (concussion), so LV's TE/RB/slot options — Bowers, Michael Mayer (20 targets, 179 yards in weeks 4-6) and Jeanty's receiving — face a backup linebacker, and their receiving prices are still coin-flip no-vig. LV TE Carter Runyon OUT (foot) is depth behind Bowers/Mayer, no usage vacuum. LV WR Dont'e Thornton Jr. OUT (hamstring) is a modest bump for Tucker, Cody White and Jakobi... Jalen Nailor, not a starter hole. Unresolved questionables, no inactives in the pack: Puka Nacua (calf) — if he sits, LA targets move to Davante Adams (20 targets weeks 4-6), Tyler Higbee (16), Kyren (27) and the depth WRs; if he plays, the 84.5 is live but a calf can cut the deep air yards (380 in three weeks). Mike Washington Jr. (foot) Q — if inactive, Jeanty's 11.7 carries/game rise and any rush-under dies. Quay Walker (chest) Q would help Higbee/Kyren/Corum receiving only if he is actually out. Trent McDuffie (groin) Q would help LV outside receivers only if he sits. Sources: pack injury report plus weeks 4-6 carry/target tables.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone chart in the pack. Proxy from six-game YPA by location: LA is soft in the middle (7.18 on 38 attempts) and tighter outside (left 5.68 on 72, right 5.08 on 71). LV is soft everywhere and worst in the middle (middle 8.56 on 34, left 7.58 on 78, right 7.89 on 81).
matchup.pressure: LV blitz rate 27%; LA EPA/db is -0.07 when blitzed and +0.16 when not, so Stafford is comfortable if LV stays off the blitz and deep shots shrink only if pressure actually arrives. LA blitz rate 30%; LV EPA/db is +0.09 vs blitz and +0.21 vs none — Cousins is better clean but not broken by pressure. Pressure that gets home should push checkdowns to Jeanty and Bowers rather than Tucker's air-yard shots (292 air yards on 20 targets in weeks 4-6).
matchup.bleeds: LV run defense bleeds: 5.18 YPC and 23 runs of 10+ in six games, plus 19 passes of 20+ for 208 yards. LA is the opposite on explosives (only 11 passes of 20+ for 189 yards) but bleeds the middle at 7.18 YPA, and the linebacker who would normally sit there (Nate Landman) is out.
matchup.overlap: The overlap to bet is LV's lead receiving pieces into that middle: Bowers (30 targets, 332 air yards over weeks 4-6, the primary option) and Jeanty (20 targets, only 37 air yards — screens and checkdowns, not a vertical WR) against a Landman-less LB room. Kyren into the 5.18 YPC run defense is a real overlap too, but his last two rush games are 49 and 50 against a 67.5 line, so it is not the ticket.

form: Ordering check: last-4 logs are oldest-first and the extra game is week 3, because weeks 4-6 totals match the last three entries (Bowers 86+110+70=266; Jeanty rush 58+27+22=107; Jeanty rec 68+50+36=154). Bowers last four recyds 116, 86, 110, 70 versus 72.5 — two of the last three cleared, the most recent was 70. Jeanty rec last four 37, 68, 50, 36, all over 25.5, floor 36. His rush has collapsed (56, 58, 27, 22), so the stable role is receiving, not rushing; rush+rec last two are 77 and 58, under 81.5. Kyren rush 88, 80, 49, 50 is trending under 67.5 with Corum taking 19 carries in three weeks. Higbee 62, 67, 83, 22 shows a real role and a 22-yard miss last game. Tucker 43, 44, 41, 97 is a one-game boom against a defense that does not yield explosives. Mayer 32, 82, 2, 95 is boom/bust next to Bowers. Puka 74, 125, 138, 80 is the LA engine but calf-questionable.

pro_edge.implied_totals: Saved scan: LV 22.8, LA 25.8. Check: favorite (48.5+3)/2 = 25.75, dog (48.5-3)/2 = 22.75. Moderate total, slight favorite, not a shootout and not a 3.5-point dog-throw flag.
pro_edge.script_read: Spread is 3.0, so the automatic underdog-throws-more rule (3.5+) is only partial. Still, Jeanty at 3.06 YPC and a 22.8 team total mean LV pass volume is the path to the number, and a 3-point game is not a blowout so starter snaps should hold. Usage from shares, not raw averages: of the listed LV skill targets in weeks 4-6 (Bowers 30, Jeanty 20, Tucker 20, Mayer 20, White 10, Washington 4, Laube 4 = 108), Bowers is 28% and Jeanty 19% — both real shares applied to a pass-leaning dog script.
pro_edge.best_price: No sharp-anchor beat on the two candidate legs. Bowers recyds 72.5 consensus no-vig 0.500/0.500, best over -114. Jeanty recyds 25.5 no-vig 0.500/0.500, best over -114. Power devig versus overround was not saved separately. The only shaded number on the board is Matthew Stafford rush under 0.5 (no-vig under 0.583, best -162), which is not a selected leg. Jeanty rush 52.5, Corum rush 36 and Kyren rush+rec 101 have no two-sided price, so they are not priced edges.
pro_edge.lagging: No spread or total move and no book-versus-consensus lag flag was saved. The qualitative lag is Landman already OUT while Bowers, Jeanty receiving and Mayer are still priced as 50/50.
pro_edge.sleepers: OUT, same-game: Nate Landman (LA LB) — replacement not named; beneficiary lines for Bowers, Mayer and Jeanty rec have not moved off coin-flip no-vig. Carter Runyon (LV TE) OUT is depth, no prop. Dont'e Thornton Jr. (LV WR) OUT — Tucker 42.5, White 11.5 and Nailor 15.5 are not juiced; low-confidence depth bump. Not sleepers: Puka, Washington, Quay Walker and McDuffie are Questionable, not out. Rerun at inactives.

edge_players.must_be_true: Bowers is healthy and keeps the lead share (he is not on the injury report), the game stays inside a blowout so Cousins keeps throwing toward the 22.8 implied total, and Landman's absence is not fully replaced by a safety bracket.
edge_players.kills_it: LA takes Bowers away and Mayer (20 targets, a 95-yard game most recently) or Tucker (97 last game, 292 air yards in three weeks) eats the production, or the game becomes a low-event slog and 70-yard outputs become the norm instead of the floor.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. LA knew Landman was out and bracketed Bowers with a safety, so Mayer (most recent 95, and 20 targets in three weeks) and Tucker (most recent 97, 292 air yards) took the explosives while Bowers finished in the 60s, under 72.5, the same neighborhood as his most recent 70. Jeanty's receiving over died because Washington was scratched, Jeanty became a pure rusher, and Cousins had time against a 30% blitz (LV EPA/db +0.21 when not blitzed) to attack the outside, where LA allows only 5.08-5.68 YPA, so the 37-air-yard dump-off role never arrived. A calf-limited Puka does not save or kill these two; a teens LV total in a slog would starve both yardage lines together. That counter-case is real but not stronger than a lead-target TE into a missing linebacker plus a receiving floor of 36 against 25.5, so neither leg is dropped. Re-check both if the inactive list changes Washington or adds a Bowers tag that is not in this report.
slip_story: One script only: LV has to throw into a depleted linebacker room. Bowers recyds over 72.5 and Jeanty recyds over 25.5 win together on middle and flat volume. Do not add Jeanty rush under, Jeanty rush+rec over, a game under, or Kyren rush over — those need a different script. Do not add Mayer, who cannibalizes Bowers. No TD legs. Puka and Washington stay off the slip until the inactive window. This is a read, not a bet.
